thread:
morgan: hit a nasty onboarding issue this morning: systemd unit had REDWOOD_API_KEY, docker-compose mounted REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN file. service used the systemd var and wrote data to the wrong project.

dina: wow. so process env > file mount? that's surprising for containers.

morgan: yup. our SDK currently checks process env first, then .env, then token files. seems fine for local dev but terrible for k8s/containers where secrets are files.

tobias: we should flip precedence for container runtimes: prefer REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN_FILE if present. keep process env primary for local CLI flows.

zack: parity issue across SDKs too: node reads files lazily, python reads at startup. we need consistent behavior: 1) canonical precedence by runtime type, 2) an explicit reloadCredentials() API for file-backed tokens.

dina: also add a small docker-entrypoint shim for our sample apps: if REDWOOD_API_KEY exists and no REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN, copy the value into an in-process REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN env var (redacted log) so devs don't get blocked. opt-in via SAMPLE_MIGRATE_LEGACY=true.

infra: for k8s charts we'll standardize on keys: redwood.project_token (file) and redwood.legacy_api_key (legacy). helm will inject both during migration window. we'll publish a migration hook.

morgan: rotation gotcha: when secret file is updated in k8s, processes that read file once won't pick up new token. proposal: SDK exposes optional FileWatcher that can watch token file and call onChange callback (opt-in for servers).

tobias: agree. default to no auto-reload so we don't surprise users, but include a helper watchFileAndReload(path, opts). add tests for race conditions and ensure no double-retries for non-idempotent requests.

zack: GH Actions: recommend using ephemeral tokens via OIDC or our `redwood/setup-token` action. docs: show example where action returns a step output token used as REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN for that job only.

dina: CLI tweaks: add `rw whoami --show-scope` and `rw auth ttl` to expose which env/file was used and remaining TTL. super helpful for debugging CI.

morgan: UX: emit a single startup WARN if legacy env present or if both legacy env and project-file exist, e.g., "Found REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN_FILE; using project token file."

infra: we'll add helm/values example and a script to atomically add both keys to secrets for the overlap window. include `kubectl rollout restart` guidance if sidecar not used.

tobias: SDK API plan: 1) unify precedence rules in docs; 2) implement reloadCredentials() and FileWatcher helper in node/python/go; 3) add AuthExpiredError with hint and `canRetry` flag; 4) opt-in autoRefresh handler for server SDKs behind a flag.

devx-bot: Please file RFC "Credential precedence by runtime + file-backed rotation" and include test matrix (node/python/go/browser), sample app checklist, and k8s migration runbook.

morgan: filed DEVX-8490 with repro, docker-compose + systemd snippets, and a WIP runbook link. i'll open sample app PR with shim and docs.

dina: i'll add tests in python client. tobias you want node? zack will handle go parity.

zack: yep. will also add e2e that rotates secret file and calls reloadCredentials() to demonstrate zero-downtime rotate.

morgan: thanks all, will post RFC link when ready. :white_check_mark:
